text:
Priya: Noticed a spike in healthscore +10 for ~1.2k accounts over the last 6h, correlated with enablement events. Looks like duplicate enablement events exported from the old CRM webhook backfill.
Tom: Yikes. Do you have an example?
Priya: Example account acct_ZXY: events: enablement_completed x3 within 90s. Payloads identical except `request_id` missing on two.
cs-analytics: ALERT: healthscore-pulse anomaly 173812 - 06:12 UTC - metric: healthscore_delta_count=1223
Kelsey: That will inflate renewal signals. Can we pause playbook-runner for enablement-triggered automations while we triage? Minimal blast radius: pause selector `automation:enablement_*` for 5m.
Amit: Suggestion: instead of full pause, gate the runner to check `event_id` uniqueness and skip if duplicate within 1h. Cheap && safe.
Tom: Do we have unique event ids in old backfill? Some older rows have null `event_guid`. Backfill writer used to leave `event_guid` empty.
Priya: Fix plan: 1) run a dedupe pass that computes a stable fingerprint (account_id|event_type|event_ts rounded to minute) and collapse duplicates; 2) apply a targeted healthscore rollback for accounts where duplicates changed score > +4; 3) add guard in playbook-runner to skip if same fingerprint seen within 1h.
Amit: I can write the dedupe tool. Outline: `tools/qa_dedupe.py --source=webhook_sink --fingerprint="sha1({account_id}+{type}+floor(min_ts))" --dryrun`
Kelsey: Also need customer-facing risk list for CS managers so they can outreach or suppress NPS pings. Priya, can you export top 200 accounts flagged?
Priya: On it, will put CSV in /shared/sheets and tag cs-managers.
devops-bot: NOTICE: paused playbook-runner group automation:enablement_* by Kelsey at 06:35 UTC (ttl 5m).
Tom: Dedupe dry-run on a 10k sample shows ~2.1% duplicates, mainly from backfills with missing event_guid. Script output: `scanned:10000, duplicates:212, collapsed:208`.
Amit: I'll run live dedupe after approvals. Command I'll use: ```bash
# collapse duplicates but keep earliest
python tools/qa_dedupe.py --source=webhook_sink --fingerprint 'sha1(account_id+"|"+event_type+"|"+to_min(event_ts))' --action collapse --confirm
```
Kelsey: Approve dedupe live + runner guard. Priya: health rollback plan?
Priya: Health rollback: compute delta caused by dedupe (pre/post) and for deltas > 4 points call `PATCH /cs/admin/accounts/{id}/healthscore` with historic value and note `reason=dedupe-correction`. Will batch in 500 requests/min.
Tom: Add an audit log entry for each manual rollback. Also add a temporary metric exposing `health_corrections_pending` so ops can watch.
Amit: Deploying runner-guard PR (branch: runner/fingerprint-skip). It checks Redis set `recent_fp:{account_id}` with TTL 3600s before firing.
devops-bot: ACTION: ticket CSOPS-5210 created - "CRM backfill duplicates -> healthscore inflation" Assigned: Priya, Kelsey, Amit.
Priya: Running live dedupe now in staging for final smoke. ETA 20m. Posting results here.
Kelsey: Noting a comms touchpoint: Flag top 50 at-risk customers to AE leads and mark them suppressed for automated renewal outreach for 48h.
Tom: I'll add the unit test for fingerprint dedupe and a small integration test to ensure rollback path doesn't exceed rate limit.
Amit: Dedupe finished in staging: `scanned:120k, duplicates:2650, collapsed:2642`. Pushing to prod now.
Priya: Prod dedupe started 07:12 UTC. I'll start health corrections once collapse completes.
cs-analytics: METRIC: healthscore_delta_count reduced to baseline after dedupe.
Kelsey: Done with AE notifications and suppression list (shared-sheets link posted).
Priya: Health corrections batch started. Using rate limit 500/min as agreed.
Tom: Runner guard merged and deployed to prod. Small canary on 10% of traffic. Monitoring for false positives.
Amit: Postmortem will include remediation steps, runbook updates: require event_guid or stable fingerprint for any ingestion, and backfills must include `idempotency_key`. I'll draft.
Priya: Thanks team. Quick retro tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Closing channel once health corrections count hits 0. :thumbsup:
